Cache sha256 values below identify exactly the data behind every number.
post_submit_code_changes: tensorbem.benchmarks.rao_truncation.band_statistics: band edges now keep a 1e-9 relative rounding slack (not called by the sweep stage)
this driver: criteria_section aggregates only the RAO-side axes for criterion (3) and reports the steady geometric axis separately (assemble stage only)
provenance.zero_hand_copying: Every numeric leaf of this artifact is produced by the stages above, by a closed-form expression evaluated at run time, or is imported from a package module (recalled reference literals, tagged UNSOURCED).

case.hull: Wigley III (Journee 1992, Report 09-V-09 model geometry, L/B = 10, B/T = 1.6)

reference_frame.head_seas: wave_angle = 180 deg (waves propagate along -x, bow at +x)

used.why: zero-speed 3-D free-surface Green-function BEM with CHIEF suppression
only solver whose fluid domain is truncated, hence the only place where a geometric truncation radius is a real knob

gaps.statement: tensorbem.rao / tensorbem.free_surface_solver3d evaluate the zero-speed Green function only (no encounter-frequency kernel and no Havelock-with-speed kernel), so the Fr = 0.142 / 0.20 RAO of the mission cannot be produced by the certified unsteady route.

tensorbem.stf_fullspeed supplies the STF assembly, the speed-correction terms and circular-section coefficients, but no hull excitation-force builder: assemble_stf_coefficients takes excitation_forces as a caller input, so an end-to-end hull RAO at forward speed cannot be produced without new, unverified physics.
The truncated-domain Rankine panel method is steady (Neumann-Kelvin); there is no unsteady free-surface patch solver, hence no radius-truncation experiment on an RAO.

reasons.statement: The KVLCC2 hull form postdates the cited source: the package cites Journee (1992) as 'Experiments and Calculations on 4 Wigley Hull Forms in Head Waves', Report 09-V-09, DUT (docstring of tensorbem.wigley3_hull).  A 1992 report cannot contain KVLCC2 experiments, so the assigned anchor is internally inconsistent and no such table can be transcribed.

No experimental RAO table is shipped in this repository.  tensorbem.reference_provenance registers every Journee literal used by the package as recalled/UNSOURCED with the note that the source report is not shipped; papers/reports/w20_seakeeping_truncation4.md records an earlier attempt to obtain the table as an honest FAIL.
Outbound network access is blocked in the execution sandbox, so the report cannot be retrieved during the run.

requested_anchor.consequence: Criteria (1) peak-RAO deviation < 15 % and (2) peak-frequency offset < 15 % are not adjudicable against the assigned anchor and are reported WITHHELD; they are not replaced by a recalled number.

analytic: long-wave Froude-Krylov limit: heave RAO -> 1, pitch RAO -> 0 as omega -> 0
closed-form Wigley geometry: Cb = 4/9 + 4 alpha/45, V = L B T Cb, A_wp = 2 L B / 3, Ixx_wp = 4 B^3 L / 105, Iyy_wp = B L^3 / 30, KB = T [1 - (15 + 5 alpha)/(40 + 8 alpha)] (= 5T/8 at alpha = 0)
ITTC (1978) two-parameter spectrum zeroth moment m0 = Hs^2 / 16
numerical: three-mesh discretisation study of the same RAO curve
head-seas convention check: |RAO| invariant under beta -> beta + pi
truncated-domain Rankine solver: pressure vs far-field wave-resistance energy gate

geometry.KB_note: KB_over_T_at_alpha_zero must be 0.625 (classical 5T/8).  The package formula returned 0.8125 before this mission's fix of tensorbem.wigley3_hull.

discretisation.note: Panel counts are not in a constant refinement ratio, so no formal GCI index is quoted; the successive-mesh changes bound the discretisation error of the RAO curve on which the truncation study is built.

recalled_literal_diagnostic.label: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- recalled literals, UNSOURCED, not an accepted anchor
recalled_literal_diagnostic.verdict: NOT ACCEPTED AS CRITERION EVIDENCE (reference is recalled, unsourced)

criterion_3_doubling_convergence.verdict: FAIL as an all-pairs criterion (23/36 doubling pairs < 3 %); the highest doubling 6.0->12.0 rad/s passes in 5/6 channel-sea-state combinations and fails marginally at 4.16 %.

rao_peak_sensitivity.caveat: Pointwise RAO peaks are interior to the band, so they cannot move once the band edge is above the resonance region; the meaningful truncation target is the band-limited response variance (axes A and B).  Pairs whose lower level cuts through the resonance region are reported as FAIL.

axis_C_steady_domain_radius.verdict: REPORTED SEPARATELY - not an RAO criterion
axis_C_steady_domain_radius.caveat: The steady Rankine solution fails its own energy consistency gate (pressure vs far-field wave resistance) at these Froude numbers, so its domain-radius convergence is a property of that functional, not evidence about RAO truncation.

criterion_3_doubling_convergence.scope_note: Axes 'truncation_frequency_upper_band' and 'truncation_radius_long_wave' are evaluated on the certified zero-speed 3-D RAO; the axis 'truncation_radius_geometric_domain' is evaluated on the truncated-domain Rankine solver (steady wave resistance), because the package has neither an unsteady truncated-domain solver nor a forward-speed unsteady free-surface solver.

limitations: The certified unsteady RAO solver is zero-speed; forward speed (Fr = 0.142 / 0.20) is NOT_SUPPORTED for RAO in this package and is exercised only on the steady truncated-domain solver (wave-resistance coefficient).
No experimental anchor is available in this environment (see anchor section), so criteria (1) and (2) are WITHHELD rather than estimated.

The 3-D Green-function RAO has no domain truncation; the 'truncation radius' of the RAO axes is therefore a wavelength-space radius (lambda_max/L), and the geometric radius is measured on the truncated-domain Rankine solver instead.
ITTC (1978) spectrum with Hs = 1 m: sigma values are transfer-function properties and scale linearly with Hs.
